basic_info.description: Welcome to an elegant San Francisco oasis at 2249 Washington Street. This sophisticated full-floor condo is ideally situated just a block from serene Lafayette Park and blocks from vibrant Fillmore Street, known for its charming boutiques and diverse dining options.  Step inside to discover a living room adorned with a classic fireplace and custom built-in bookcase, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen, complete with a breakfast counter, seamlessly flows into the dining room, offering a perfect setting for entertaining. Adjacent to the kitchen, a deck awaits, ideal for barbecuing and enjoying outdoor meals.  The generously sized primary bedroom boasts an en suite bath and a spacious walk-in closet. French doors open to a private deck, leading to a large, sunny shared garden, a true urban retreat. The second bedroom also features French doors that provide access to the deck and garden, enhancing the indoor-outdoor living experience.  Additional features include hardwood floors, elegant crown molding, estate shutters, and the convenience of French doors to the deck and garden. The garage offers the rare luxury of two-car parking, a full-size washer and dryer, and two storage units. Experience refined city living in this exceptional San Francisco home.
